examples.title: Replace one file, keep everything else byte-identical

description: Edit an existing archive without recompressing anything: operations add / replace / remove / rename / setComment applied in order. mode 'append' (default) = save(): the original bytes stay verbatim and edits are appended — fast and byte-preserving, BUT removed or replaced payloads REMAIN in the file (data remanence: recoverable by anyone; a ZIP_DEAD_BYTES_RATIO diagnostic fires past 50 % dead bytes, and 7-Zip is known to read the stale payload). mode 'compact' = saveCompact(): a rewrite without the dead bytes, entries SORTED by raw name bytes (an insertion-ordered layout — EPUB mimetype first, JAR manifest first — is not kept; 'append' keeps it), still no recompression, removed data truly gone, SFX prefix dropped; add `canonical: {…}` for the canonical deterministic form (zipnative 1.1.0, the canonicalize_zip rules applied after the edits). No edits and an unchanged comment return the same bytes (`summary.noOp`). The input is opened eagerly and, in 'append' mode, every entry is cross-checked against its local header and declared sizes before its bytes are re-emitted (ZIP_ENTRY_OVERLAP / ZIP_CD_LFH_MISMATCH / ZIP_LIMIT_EXCEEDED). Entry names travel verbatim (an unsafe name stays unsafe — extract_zip sanitises on the way out). Archives with duplicate entry names are refused — prefer create_zip for a full rebuild or when the source has duplicate names. Output base64 or a sandbox file.

canonical.description: mode 'compact' only (zipnative 1.1.0 saveCompact({ canonical })): after the edits, rewrite every entry into the canonical deterministic form — sorted by raw name bytes, one timestamp, UTF-8 flags, Zip64-only extras, version-made-by 0x032D — still without recompression. `{}` takes the defaults. The same rules as canonicalize_zip.

date.description: The one timestamp written on every entry (ISO-8601, 1980-01-01 … 2107-12-31, read as UTC; 2-second DOS granularity). Default: the DOS epoch 1980-01-01T00:00:00 — the deterministic default. Pass the same value to inspect_zip `canonicalDate` to verify the result.

keepComments.description: Keep the archive comment and the entry comments (default false: the canonical form carries none).

keepExternalAttributes.description: Keep each entry's external attributes — Unix modes, DOS attributes (default true); false writes the canonical defaults (0o100644 files, 0o40755 directories).

compression.description: Compression settings. `method` 'deflate' (default) or 'store'; `level` 0–9 (default 6); `deterministic: true` pins the pure-TS encoder so the bytes are identical on every runtime (slower).

deterministic.description: true pins the pure-TS encoder: identical bytes on every runtime (slower).

defaultDate.description: Timestamp for entries that set no `date`: an ISO-8601 instant (1980-01-01 … 2107-12-31, 2-second DOS granularity) or 'now' (wall clock — emits the ZIP_TIMESTAMP_NOT_PINNED diagnostic and makes the bytes non-reproducible). Omitted: the DOS epoch 1980-01-01T00:00:00 (reproducible).

limits.description: Per-call override of zipnative's security bounds (CWE-400/409); absent keys keep the engine defaults (describe_engine.defaultLimits). A value above its operator ceiling is LIMIT_CEILING_EXCEEDED. Raise only for trusted input.

maxEntryCompressedSize.description: Bytes, one compressed payload fetched by the byte-range reader (access range).

mode.description: 'append' (default): save() — original bytes verbatim + appended entries + new central directory; removed/replaced payloads REMAIN in the file (data remanence). 'compact': saveCompact() — a rewrite without recompression, entries sorted by raw name bytes, removed data truly gone, SFX prefix dropped (add `canonical` for the canonical deterministic form).

operations.description: Edits applied in order. add: new entry (ZIP_ENTRY_EXISTS if present); replace: existing entry (ZIP_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND otherwise); remove; rename (never overwrites: remove the target first); setComment.

compression.description: Compression settings. `method` 'deflate' (default) or 'store'; `level` 0–9 (default 6); `deterministic: true` pins the pure-TS encoder so the bytes are identical on every runtime (slower).

deterministic.description: true pins the pure-TS encoder: identical bytes on every runtime (slower).

dataBase64.description: File content as base64. Exclusive with text / sourcePath.

date.description: ISO-8601 last-modified instant for this entry, 1980-01-01 … 2107-12-31 (overrides defaultDate; 2-second DOS granularity).

directory.description: add only: an explicit directory entry.

externalAttributes.description: Raw external attributes (uint32). Exclusive with unixMode.

extraFields.description: Extra fields to embed verbatim (id 0–65535 except 0x0001, the Zip64 record the engine owns). The caller owns their determinism.

dataBase64.description: Payload bytes as base64 (may be empty).

id.description: Extra-field header id (0–65535; 0x0001 is reserved for the engine).

name.description: Entry name, '/'-separated. Directories end in '/' (or set `directory: true`).

op.description: 'add' a new entry (ZIP_ENTRY_EXISTS if present) or 'replace' an existing one (ZIP_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND otherwise).

sourcePath.description: Relative path of a file inside the ZIPNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sandbox to read the content from (any extension). Exclusive with dataBase64 / text.

text.description: File content as UTF-8 text. Exclusive with dataBase64 / sourcePath.

unixMode.description: Unix permission bits as 3–4 octal digits ('0644', '755', '0o755'); mapped to external attributes. Exclusive with externalAttributes.

op.description: Remove an entry (its bytes remain in the file under mode append).
Rename an entry without recompression; never overwrites an existing name.

outputMode.description: 'base64' (default): inline embedded resource (≤ 50 MiB; the bytes appear in both its data: uri and its blob). 'file': written into the sandbox (never overwrites; ≤ ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_FILE_OUTPUT_BYTES, default 4 GiB) and returned as a resource_link — far fewer tokens.

outputPath.description: Relative path inside the sandbox (only when outputMode='file'); must end in a container extension (.zip recommended).

strict.description: Turn the first engine diagnostic into a ZIP_STRICT_DIAGNOSTIC error.

zipBase64.description: Archive bytes, base64 (≤ 128 MiB decoded). Exclusive with zipPath.

zipPath.description: Archive path relative to the ZIPNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sandbox (container extensions: .zip .jar .docx .epub …). Exclusive with zipBase64; saves re-sending bytes between calls.

name: modify_zip

outputSchema.description: Archive result: base64 mode = an embedded `resource` block (not repeated here); file mode = `filePath` + a resource_link.

diagnostics.description: Non-fatal engine concerns (de-duplicated by code + entry, ≤ 200; codes in describe_engine.diagnosticCodes). Empty for a clean archive.

diagnosticsTruncated.description: true when rows beyond 200 were dropped.

canonical.description: Present (true) when the compact rewrite produced the canonical deterministic form (input canonical).

grewByBytes.description: outputBytes − inputBytes (negative after a compacting rewrite).

noOp.description: true when the engine returned the input buffer unchanged (no pending edit, same comment).
